name: Umami
description: Privacy-friendly website analytics, a Google Analytics alternative

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with your websites and visits, and state/secrets.env, this install's own keys made on first start. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Umami dashboard, tracker script and collect API, published on host as 6750

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the admin account. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used while admin still has Umami's built-in password; once you change it in Umami, yours is kept.
